name: What types of kitchen sinks can Hometelligent install?

mainEntity.name: What types of kitchen sinks can Hometelligent install?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent installs various kitchen sink types, including drop-in (top-mount), undermount, farmhouses/apron-front, and integrated sinks. The best option for your kitchen often depends on your existing countertop material and cabinet structure. For example, undermount sinks offer a seamless look but require a solid surface countertop, while farmhouse sinks may necessitate cabinet modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: We install drop-in, undermount, farmhouse, and integrated kitchen sinks. The suitable type depends on your countertop and cabinet structure.
